description: Shared normalization and containment examples for the v2 release contract. TypeScript (scripts/release-quality-gate.ts) and Python (tests/evals/contracts.py) both load this file and must produce the listed results. Normalization is exactly: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace runs to one space (leading/trailing runs are not trimmed). Numbers, units and negation characters are preserved; fullwidth punctuation is compatibility-normalized by NFKC. Containment is substring matching over normalized text. Substring matching cannot prove general semantics: the reviewed finite prohibited assertions and the semantic judge remain responsible for contradictions not listed here.
